requirement_families.title: Civic Canopy RFQ Output and Reuse

requirements.title: RCP Proposal Layout
requirements.definition: Provide layout and graphic treatment for the RCP proposal and its design-focused pages.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the RCP document layout itself; branding, resume treatment, optional custom graphics, compliance constraints, and delivered file formats can change independently.

requirements.title: RCP Proposal Branding
requirements.definition: Apply the required branding treatment to the RCP proposal materials.
requirements.boundary_note: Brand identity treatment is independently adjustable and is not merged with general page layout.

requirements.title: RCP Resume Materials
requirements.definition: Design and format resumes and related personnel materials for the RCP proposal.
requirements.boundary_note: Resume treatment is a distinct proposal component that can be requested or revised without changing the general layout or branding.

requirements.title: RCP Proposal Format Compliance
requirements.definition: Ensure the RCP proposal follows applicable page-count, file-size, and related submission-format rules.
requirements.boundary_note: Submission constraints are independently verifiable and remain separate from visual quality and source-file delivery.

requirements.title: RCP Optional Infographics and Maps
requirements.definition: Provide custom infographics and maps only if they remain necessary after review of the reusable prior template and final RFP.
requirements.boundary_note: Maps and infographics are a contingent visual-asset scope that may be omitted while the rest of the RCP proposal design remains required.

requirements.title: RCP Source Files and Final PDFs
requirements.definition: Deliver the original RCP design files together with the final PDF outputs.
requirements.boundary_note: File ownership and delivery formats are independently testable and are not attributes of the proposal's visual layout.

requirements.title: RFQ Full-Document Layout
requirements.definition: Apply coherent graphic treatment and layout across the complete Civic Canopy RFQ response.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the overall page-layout system; branding, typography, photographs, special-page backgrounds, tables, biographies, and output behavior have separate acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Blue Mesa Strategies Branding
requirements.definition: Design the RFQ response around Blue Mesa Strategies' identity rather than Civic Canopy's branding.
requirements.boundary_note: The selected brand identity can change independently from document layout and from the separately deferred reusable-template system.

requirements.title: RFQ Typography Consistency
requirements.definition: Use consistent and appropriate font types and sizes within each applicable proposal section.
requirements.boundary_note: Typography consistency has its own acceptance criterion and includes resolution of intentional versus editorial bolding without absorbing other visual-design changes.

requirements.title: RFQ Photo Selection and Framing
requirements.definition: Use the approved photographs, include mandatory marked images, and present each selected photo with the required placement and crop.
requirements.boundary_note: Individual page selections, removals, relocations, and crops are attributes of one photo-presentation mechanism rather than separate Requirements per image.

requirements.title: RFQ Special-Page Background Treatment
requirements.definition: Apply the client-approved background treatment to the cover, table of contents, appendix divider, and final page.
requirements.boundary_note: The shared background treatment for the identified special pages was revised independently from the document's general layout.

requirements.title: RFQ Cover Letter Format
requirements.definition: Format the proposal letter as a one-page letter that supports insertion of the client's signature and appropriate relocation of displaced images.
requirements.boundary_note: The one-page letter and signature accommodation can be modified independently from the overall proposal page limit and other photo layouts.

requirements.title: Fixed RFQ Section Order
requirements.definition: Preserve the section order mandated by the client's question-and-answer guidance and supplied document skeleton.
requirements.boundary_note: Section sequence is a fixed structural constraint distinct from whether every required subsection and content item is present.

requirements.title: Complete RFQ Section Content
requirements.definition: Package the required narrative and subsection content into the RFQ response without omitting required sections.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers inclusion of required narrative sections and subsections; tables, biographies, photographs, and the organization chart are independently managed asset types.

requirements.title: RFQ Table Integration
requirements.definition: Insert and format the current approved tables, including budget and payment-schedule structures, in the proposal.
requirements.boundary_note: All table replacements and row-structure changes belong to one independently evolving table-integration mechanism.

requirements.title: RFQ Biography Appendix
requirements.definition: Provide and populate the appendix structure needed for the additional Signal Grove Studio team biographies.
requirements.boundary_note: Biography placeholders and their replacement with completed bios form one trajectory separate from tables and general appendix styling.

requirements.title: RFQ Organization Chart Placement
requirements.definition: Place and format the organization chart within the final RFQ response.
requirements.boundary_note: The organization chart is a separately identifiable required artifact and is not merged with independently changing tables, photos, or biographies.

requirements.title: RFQ Page-Limit Compliance
requirements.definition: Keep the RFQ response within the applicable page limit by using appropriately compact spacing and layout.
requirements.boundary_note: Overall page-count compliance is independently verifiable; the separate one-page letter constraint remains under the cover-letter Requirement.

requirements.title: Editable Canva Access and Ownership
requirements.definition: Deliver an editable Canva design that the client owns and can revise without requiring a paid Canva subscription.
requirements.boundary_note: Current-document editing access, ownership, and use of free Canva assets are one mechanism; a reusable modular system for future proposals is a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Reusable Modular Proposal Template
requirements.definition: Provide a reusable proposal-template system with swappable narrative sections, resizable table styles, and a client-specific prepared-for line.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently priced reusable system for future proposals, not merely the ability to edit the current RFQ file; the client later places it outside the current task.

requirements.title: Email-Ready Final PDF
requirements.definition: Export the finalized response as a single clean, print-ready PDF compressed sufficiently for email submission.
requirements.boundary_note: Single-file export, print readiness, and email-compatible compression are attributes of one final PDF deliverable; hyperlink functionality is separately verifiable.

requirements.title: Final PDF Hyperlink Integrity
requirements.definition: Preserve functioning proposal hyperlinks through layout, revision, and final PDF export.
requirements.boundary_note: Hyperlink functionality can fail or be verified independently from PDF file size, export completion, and visual quality.
